doc: The pipeline call without offset: 64 rows x 128, float32 s, fine, streak and subtexel, the zonal target of climate.target_zonal_coverage per row (stored), default GenParams, offset left at its default 0.0. 36 bisection steps on [-10, 10]: the result is the midpoint of a final bracket 20 / 2^36 = 2.9e-10 wide, a dyadic number. A decision flips only when a row mean lies within an ulp of the target. What limits agreement is the conditioning: a float32 rounding of 1 + a_fine fine, or a one-ulp change of an input, moves the root by about 1e-8 (see the measurement). Tolerance is the golden float32 default. Arguments: s, fine, target, streak, subtexel and offset are the inputs of that name when listed; an unlisted streak or offset (default 0.0) is the scalar in params, an unlisted subtexel is None; prm holds the GenParams fields compose reads. The 36 steps and the bracket [-10, 10] are literals of the source. Measured: promoting the float32 inputs to float64 changes the output by at most 1.7e-8; one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 4.7e-8 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is about 1e2x the larger of the two spreads.
